author: Upsoar
body: This is pretty self explanatory but can go into different depths. Basically, players would be rewarded for doing damage to a player who is killed by another teammate. The XP gained is not equal to that of the player who got the kill (Maybe about half or so). Some servers also give out a certain amount of XP proportional to the amount of damage the player inflicts on someone. (So someone that gets an assist after dealing 5 hearts of damage would receive more XP than someone who dealt 1 heart) [This is only an additional suggestion, less data would be used without the tracking of damage done].  I know plugins for this are already in use - But I don't know if a public one is available. For this to work, it may need to be custom coded. (Again, Damage and XP coordination wouldn't be necessary, just another suggestion)
